result.brief: Two-storey private residential duplex in Ikoyi, Lagos measured from an architecture-only IFC model. Substructure is strip wall footings with concrete foundation walls and ground slab on grade. External walls are 193mm concrete blockwork with rigid insulation, metal furring and 92mm facing brickwork, upper floor is timber joists with plywood subfloor assisted by W310 and W410 steel beams. The flat timber roof build-up was held out as uncertain, and the model lacks structural detailing, M&E services, roof covering and external services.

facts.frame: Concrete blockwork walls with structural steel beams and timber-joisted upper floor
facts.exclusions: Loose furniture; stair assembly members; flat roof slab held for uncertainty

questions.question: Flat timber roof slab type held out - confirm roof construction, covering, insulation, drainage and ceiling build-up and where to measure?
L017 staircase and L018 stair flight both 2nr for same stairs - is this double counting and what is construction, balustrade and finish?
No structural or M&E model - confirm concrete mixes, reinforcement, steel connections, electrical, plumbing, HVAC and sanitary ware basis for BOQ?
DPM membrane and anti-termite and edge formwork measured under both Substructure and External works - ground floor vs exterior paving split correct or duplicated?
Confirm concrete mixes and reinforcement to foundation walls, ground slab, exterior slab and strip footings?
Party wall blockwork, stud and lining measured 123.78m2 - is this a semi-detached shared wall and who owns/measures it?
Confirm external wall build-up: blockwork + 41mm stud + 50mm rigid insulation + 92mm brick + 16mm plasterboard, and mortar mixes and ties?
Timber joists measured as area only with grade/size to be confirmed - confirm joist sizes, centres, treatment and plywood thickness/fixings?
All windows, skylights and doors lack frame/leaf material, glazing type and ironmongery - confirm aluminium/timber/steel and glazing?
Confirm guard rail, handrail and stair balustrade material, height and fixings?
Confirm kitchen worktops, cabinets and vanity units materials, sanitary ware, taps and wastes included?
Confirm ceiling system: 12mm plasterboard on 45mm stud - suspended grid, brand and finish/painting?
